easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana for each charge counter on it.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
